subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should embedded `after_compaction` hooks gain a permanent, current-session-scoped reset API?
rationale: This adds a public plugin capability and defines which compaction lifecycles may rotate session state, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish the intended long-term contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Support `resetSession(reason?)` only after successful compaction on resettable sessions, with lifecycle-owned deferred flushing and equivalent coverage for every emitter.

options.title: Keep hooks observational
options.body: Reject the hook API and implement any required post-compaction recovery entirely within the core session or compaction owner.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Support `resetSession(reason?)` only after successful compaction on resettable sessions, with lifecycle-owned deferred flushing and equivalent coverage for every emitter.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this person to both reset hooks and plugin-controlled compaction lifecycle design.
